in.question: Which Amazon EC2 instance family is specifically engineered for deep learning inference workloads?
in.answer: Inf2 Instances are purpose-built for deep learning inference workloads [1].

in.question: What object storage service provides 11 9s of data durability along with lifecycle tiering and WORM compliance via Object Lock?
in.answer: Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) provides 11 9s of data durability along with lifecycle tiering and WORM compliance via Object Lock [1][2].
sources: [1] aws-overview > Overview of Amazon Web Services > AWS services by category > Storage
[2] aws-overview > Overview of Amazon Web Services > AWS services by category > Storage

in.question: What fully managed, elastic POSIX-compliant file system allows concurrent access from multiple EC2 instances and containers?
in.answer: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) provides a simple, scalable, elastic file system for Linux-based workloads for use with AWS Cloud services and on-premises resources [1].
sources: [1] aws-overview > Overview of Amazon Web Services > AWS services by category > Storage

in.question: Which key-value and document NoSQL database provides single-digit millisecond performance at high scale?
in.answer: Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. [1][2]

in.question: Which serverless interactive query service lets users analyze S3 data directly using standard SQL syntax?
in.answer: Amazon Athena is the serverless interactive query service that lets users analyze S3 data directly using standard SQL syntax [1][2].

in.question: Which end-to-end machine learning platform enables developers to build, train, tune, and deploy custom ML models at scale?
in.answer: Amazon SageMaker enables developers to build, train, tune, and deploy custom ML models at scale [2][3].

in.question: In a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, what purpose does the Vector Data Store serve?
in.answer: The Vector Data Store serves the purpose of efficient storage and retrieval of high-dimensional vector embeddings [1].

in.question: What is the main role of a Multi-Tenant Enterprise AI Gateway when deployed in front of foundation models?
in.answer: The main role of a Multi-Tenant Enterprise AI Gateway is to securely route inference requests across multiple foundation models and deployment backends [3].

in.question: Which API call mechanism captures real-time end-user sentiment and quality feedback in Amazon Q?
